translations.web: “ ‘ “They shall not shave their heads, or allow their locks to grow long. They shall only cut off the hair of their heads.
translations.bsb: They must not shave their heads or let their hair grow long, but must carefully trim their hair.
translations.kjv: Neither shall they shave their heads, nor suffer their locks to grow long; they shall only poll their heads.
translations.asv: Neither shall they shave their heads, nor suffer their locks to grow long; they shall only cut off the hair of their heads.
